name: VisualStateMachineRunner
src_typeComment: Drives a VisualStateMachineAsset at runtime by building a Toolkit.Core.StateMachine from its nodes/transitions/parameters — reuses that existing engine rather than a second transition-evaluation implementation. The asset stays scene-independent (like an Animator Controller); THIS component provides the per-scene-instance bindings from node name to an actual IState-implementing behaviour. A node with no binding just runs as an empty state — useful for pure transition/organizational nodes that don't need their own script.  Initialize()/TickStateMachine() are public (not just private Awake/Update bodies) specifically so this can be driven and asserted on directly from an Editor self-test without needing Play mode.

src_serialized.name: stateBindings
src_serialized.tooltip: Binds each state node (by name) to the script that actually runs its Enter/Tick/Exit logic.
